UR | Department Portal | SEVI Dashboard | State Overview | Incomplete Theme Propagation for Dark Mode on Dashboard Canvas

URL: https://unifiedregistry-department-portal.amnex.co.in/department/sevidashboard (Specifically affects the SEVI State Overview module workspace)

Summary: The application's dark mode theme fails to fully propagate down to the analytics components. When a user clicks the theme toggle utility button in the header bar, the peripheral structures—such as the vertical navigation sidebar, top navigation band, and master page wrapper—successfully paint dark theme variables. However, the core SEVI Dashboard body canvas ignores this state shift, remaining stuck in light mode with high-contrast white card backgrounds.

Issue Details
An inspection of the dashboard theme layout verified via image_af8558.png isolates a CSS class injection or theme variable mapping breakdown across the inner workspace containers:

Incomplete Theme Mixin Allocation: The persistent structural frames (the left sidebar container and the top user status bar) adapt correctly, switching to deep charcoal/navy background states (#1e293b / #0f172a equivalents).

Isolated Light Canvas Layout: In contrast, the main analytics panel area remains entirely unaltered. The parent content viewport container, filter strip block backgrounds, informational metrics overview cards, and charting widget frames remain forced into a bright white state (#ffffff). This incomplete transition creates an unpleasant high-contrast visual clash and compromises readability.

Steps to Reproduce
1. Open the Department Portal workspace and log in using verified administrative or department credentials.
2. Click on the theme toggle button (the sun/moon icon) located inside the top right corner utility cluster of the persistent header band (image_af8558.png).
3. Confirm that the application shell transitions into its dark mode presentation layout.
4. Navigate to Sevi Dashboard > State Overview using the vertical sidebar menu drawer.
5. Observe the background color mapping applied to the metric analytics widgets and main content canvas.

Expected Result
The dark theme context must pass seamlessly down to all child modules. Turning dark mode on should trigger a global update that adapts the background, card elements, input panels, text fonts, and data charting canvases of the SEVI Dashboard to use cohesive, dark-palette CSS variables.

Actual Result
The interface exhibits an incomplete theme transition; the main web workspace frame changes correctly, but the core analytical charts and data component cards stay rendered in full light mode.

Severity: Minor | Priority: Low | Classification: Issue | Test Phase: Smoke
